user.title: Awqat mosque
user.description: Search mosques published on awqat.fr, or list mosques near this Home Assistant location.

mosque.title: Choose mosque
mosque.description: Prayer times will follow this mosque's Awqat timetable, including its calendar and iqama offsets.

azan.title: Azan automation
azan.description: Create an automation that fires at Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha. It can pause TVs and other media, then play the azan on a speaker you choose next.

iqama.title: Iqama automation
iqama.description: Create a separate automation that fires at iqama for the five daily prayers. It pauses TVs and other media so the room is quiet for prayer.

jumua.title: Jumua automation
jumua.description: Create a Friday Jumua automation. It pauses other media and can play the azan at Jumua time.

media.title: Azan speaker and TVs
media.description: Pick a speaker to play the azan. Optionally pick TVs or other media players to pause and mute when azan or iqama starts. Leave blank to only send a notification. You can change this later in the integration options.

data.pause_players: Pause and mute these TVs or media players

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Awqat. Try again in a moment.
error.search_required: Enter a mosque or city, or enable nearby search.

init.title: Azan, iqama and media
init.description: Choose which automations to keep. The azan speaker plays the mosque adhan. TVs and other media players are paused and muted when azan, iqama or Jumua starts.

data.pause_players: Pause and mute these TVs or media players
